This bulletin includes coordinated influence operation campaigns terminated on our platforms in Q3 2026. It was last updated on October 30, 2026.

July

  • We terminated 560 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Azerbaijan. The campaign was sharing content in Azerbaijani that was supportive of Azerbaijan and critical of Armenia and critics of the Azerbaijani government.
  • We terminated 6,103 YouTube channels as part of our ongoing investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to the People’s Republic of China (PRC). The campaign was sharing content in Chinese and English about China and United States foreign affairs. These findings are consistent with our previous reports.
  • We terminated 89 YouTube channels and 1 Blogger blog as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to China. The campaign was sharing content that was supportive of China and critical of the United States.
  • We terminated 6 YouTube channels and 11 Blogger blogs as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to China. The campaign was sharing content that was supportive of China and critical of the United States.
  • We terminated 545 YouTube channels as part of our ongoing investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to India. The campaign was sharing content in Marathi that was supportive of an Indian political party.
  • We terminated 6,888 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Indonesia. The campaign was sharing content in Bahasa that was supportive of the Indonesian government and its administration.
  • We terminated 17 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in English, Indonesian, Portuguese, Russian, and Telugu that was supportive of the Indonesian government.
  • We terminated 1 YouTube channel as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Iran. The campaign was sharing content in Farsi, Azerbaijani, and Dari that was supportive of Iran and critical of Israel and the United States.
  • We terminated 89 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Japan. The campaign was sharing content in Japanese that was supportive of Ukraine and critical of Iran, Russia, and of Japanese political figures.
  • We terminated 112 YouTube channels as part of our ongoing investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Pakistan. The campaign was sharing content in English and Urdu that was supportive of the Pakistani military.
  • We terminated 4 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Iran. The campaign was sharing content in English that was supportive of Iran and critical of Israel and the United States.
  • We terminated 39 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Serbia. The campaign was sharing content in Serbian that was supportive of the Serbian government.
  • We terminated 899 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Russia. The campaign was linked to a Russian consulting firm and was sharing content in Russian that was supportive of Russia and critical of Ukraine, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), and the West.
  • We terminated 106 YouTube channels as part of our ongoing investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Russia. The campaign was sharing content in Romanian and Russian that was critical of the Moldovan government and supportive of Moldova’s pro-Russian political opposition.
  • We terminated 60 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Russia. The campaign was sharing content in Russian that was supportive of the Russian government and critical of Ukraine.
  • We blocked 1 domain from eligibility to appear on Google News surfaces and Discover as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations linked to Russia. The campaign was sharing content in Russian that was supportive of Russia and critical of Ukraine.
  • We terminated 310 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in Ukrainian that was supportive of Ukraine.
  • We terminated 27 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in Ukrainian that was supportive of Ukraine.
  • We terminated 115 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in Filipino that was supportive of the Philippine government.
  • We terminated 37 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in Japanese that was critical of a Japanese political party.
  • We terminated 21 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in French that was supportive of the Republic of Congo government.
  • We terminated 18 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in Spanish that was critical of Colombia's government.
  • We terminated 18 YouTube channels as part of our investigation into coordinated influence operations. The campaign was sharing content in French that was critical of the French government.
